timing_adaptations.crown_handover: ScarletNote.Lead was `plan.Pulse > 0` (the previous note fired on this note's Born). With protocol80 notes (cell A fires on eighths 6, 9, 12 and warns from 4, 7, 10; cell B 7, 10, 12 from 5, 8, 10; signature steps 7, 10, 13, 16 from 5, 8, 11, 14) only cell B's third note opens as another strikes, and the old rule would have started every later note at the previous strike's far-side peak (a jump from rest). Lead is now derived from the plans in ScarletNotes.Collect (another non-crossflow note of the source fires on exactly this Born; a property of the plans, not of the collected window). TryFrom leaves it false. Domain test "only a note whose warning opens as another strikes takes the swing over" pins it for cells A and B and a signature phrase against an oracle at every half tick.
timing_adaptations.crown_swing_out: Crown() kept only the latest closed note's swing out while not swinging and dropped it when the next swing began. The new gaps (a strike and the next warning one eighth apart, 14-15 ticks) leave the previous swing out at up to +-1 px when the next note begins (the window-edge test found -0.52 px in 1/32 tick). The swing out of every closed note that was not handed over now carries on beneath the next swing and fades with its own window (phi = swing + follow): continuous at every Born, Fire and close. The golden against the approved prototype (chained notes, single notes) is unchanged, because there every closed note but the last was handed over.
timing_adaptations.mantle_direction: ScarletNote derived the rope's side from its row (`low ? 1 : -1`, the low comb ran rightward). #117 made the odd steps the low comb (RopeIsLow = (note & 1) == 1) while CrimsonSignatureMoves.Write still crosses rightward on even steps, so the Mantle would have cut against the strike on every step. Side is now `(Pulse & 1) == 0 ? 1 : -1`.
timing_adaptations.tests_adapted: ScarletMotionPhrase builds the real phrase from CrimsonChoreography.Create (an ordinary phrase: three cell notes then the closer, pulse 4; a signature phrase: four steps, no crossflow); every test that indexed note 4 as the crossflow uses the last plan or the phrase's latest close; the motion/edge/lookback/command/particle/Choir-blood tests also run cell B (serial 2); the rake tests run both cells so all four entry edges are covered; the crossflow note is asserted from an ordinary phrase's closer (two-beat charge). The edge test's velocity bounds are per channel now: the Crown's offset and turn 6 px and 3 centi-radians per tick (about 4.2 px/tick at its fastest; this is what catches a sub-pixel step), the Mantle's whip 15 (its steepest approved motion is 14 px/tick, which a neighbouring window edge now coincides with), the pour jolt 12.
timing_adaptations.residue_yield: ScarletResidueYield follows Pulse + 1 of the same technique, unchanged: signature steps are still pulses 0-3 in order. The next step's forecast opens 14 ticks after the previous strike instead of on it, so the residue is under a forecast for longer; the offline gate G13 and the preview's contract pass (138 signature residue strokes, 51 keep the full residue, 0 wrong).
timing_adaptations.vespera_cast: ConductorNotes / ConductorCast are unchanged. A phrase's first window can open one eighth (14 ticks) after the closing crossflow's window ended (cell B or a signature move after a closing crossflow), eight ticks between her cast windows, so she eases toward the idle pose between them (15 ticks below full pose, 9 fully idle). The pose gate in G6v found no blink (a dip of at most 8 ticks) but could not see these rests; the 0.3.91 review measures and reports them (merge_0_3_91.review.vespera_breath). Corrected: this entry first claimed no dip in any scene.

review.source: the final pre-merge review of PR #112 (four findings) and the owner's call on the crossflow's ends
review.crossflow_cut: real, and the owner's decision (魔法陣の挟み込み以外はいい; 半円の形の両脇がださすぎる; もとの表現のぶつ切りの切り方でエフェクトだけ今回のもの). The 0.3.83 capsule's round ends stop on the seal centres but stick out beside the seals' narrow ellipses (half-width 51.8 px at full charge against a 140 px radius). Fixed as drawing only: ScarletInkStroke draws the live stream and its scar for SideBeams as the band over the capsule's whole span (hi = max(A.x, B.x) + r, lo = min(A.x, B.x) - r, half-width r), the shader's own segment is the band and the quad stops at both ends (u range [e/(cut+2e), (cut+e)/(cut+2e)]), so the compiled ScarletInk shader and its pinned hashes are untouched and every other stroke is drawn as before. The band's x = 0 is the fixed right end, so the flow no longer slides while the width eases. CrimsonGestureVisuals.DrawTrackingBeams draws the crossflow's seals in its loop for age < End, under the forecast and the ink (the original order); the sealsOver list is gone, in the game, the field preview (the --seals switch is gone) and the rig harness.
